crossRefs.note: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear Yahweh all day long.
Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says Yahweh: “but I will look to this man…
I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will…
True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your…
He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t…
The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and…
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you…

translations.web: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
translations.bsb: Blessed is the man who is always reverent, but he who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
translations.kjv: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
translations.asv: Happy is the man that feareth alway; But he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
